items.summary: Add a new primary navigation item labeled "Pages" next to the existing "Groups" item in the bottom navigation, and make it navigate to a new route at "/pages".
On the existing Groups page header, add a "Create Page" button placed beside the existing "Create Group" button; clicking it should navigate users to a new route at "/pages/create".

Create a new Pages listing screen at route "/pages" and a Create Page screen at route "/pages/create". The Create Page screen must include a form with the following fields and basic client-side validation: Page Name (required), Category (Politics / News / Business / Community / Public Figure), Description, Profile Image upload, Cover Image upload, Visibility (Public / Private), and a Verification request toggle. Submitting the form should show an English user-facing message indicating the creation flow is not yet persisted (until backend support is implemented).
Add a new static icon asset for the bottom navigation "Pages" item and use it in the same way the existing Groups icon is used (image-based icon).
